corpora.title: ספריית אגודת חסידי חב״ד
corpora.notes: On 2026-11-13, five public Igrot Kodesh item pages were reviewed through search-visible Hebrew body excerpts. Direct page opens returned zero readable lines, so item-level records remain context_status=partial and claims are restricted to visible excerpts. One item is explicitly a free Hebrew translation of a Russian letter and is marked non-independent. Corpus-level Indexed status does not imply that all items or full page bodies are verified. On 2026-11-13, the direct Yiddish original-letter link /admur/ig/8/2480 returned zero readable lines; no access-control bypass was attempted. An English translated excerpt AID 2313660 was inspected and linked to the Yiddish Evidence Family as non-independent. On 2026-11-13, content batch 072 added eleven new Hebrew item identities from Chabad Library. Each was supported only by a substantive body excerpt visible in a public search result; direct item-page opens returned zero readable lines, so all remain context_status=partial and claims are restricted to those excerpts. Eighteen non-verbatim propositions were added. The separate /books/1200710342 candidate was excluded because it already existed as a free Hebrew translation from Russian in batch 068; it was not counted as an independent witness. Three Chabad.org AIDs redirected to rewritten shells and one HebrewBooks PDF page returned an internal error; alternative Chabad Library excerpts were used. No full text copied or access control bypassed.
